name: fluorescence_insitu
description: Ocean Optics Flame in-situ series: one file per spectrum in the experiment's folder. A header ('Date: Sun May 11 18:11:09 CEST 2025', integration time, ...) ends with '>>>>>Begin Spectral Data<<<<<'; then wavelength and signal, tab-separated. The file name ends with the time to the millisecond (..._18-11-09-757): the header date plus those milliseconds give each spectrum's timestamp.
